title: South Korea Set to Let 3,500 Companies Buy Bitcoin, Report Says
summary: Bitcoin Magazine South Korea Set to Let 3,500 Companies Buy Bitcoin, Report Says South Korea's Financial Services Commission plans to release guidelines next week that would let about 3,500 listed companies and professional-investor firms invest in bitcoin and other crypto, News1 reported. This post South Korea Set to Let 3,500 Companies Buy Bitcoin, Report Says first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
